replacements.en: Add white sketch-style outlines around the characters, doodle hearts, swirls, sparkles, and whimsical decorative elements to create a magical storytelling atmosphere.
replacements.zh-CN: 在角色周围加上白色速写风描边，以及涂鸦爱心、漩涡、闪光和充满童趣的装饰元素，营造神奇的故事氛围。

replacements.en: Add doodle hearts, swirls, sparkles, and whimsical decorative elements to create a magical storytelling atmosphere, without outlines around the characters.
replacements.zh-CN: 加入涂鸦爱心、漩涡、闪光和充满童趣的装饰元素，营造神奇的故事氛围，角色周围不加描边。
